claim: Per AKKI (Asosiasi Kreator Konten Indonesia) founding board member Adrian Zakhary, Indonesia has approximately 17 million content creators -- consistent with the '17 juta' total used as the denominator in the Menekraf's separate 8-juta/63-persen claim, but with no methodology given.
stance_target: total size of Indonesia's content creator population
scope_conditions: Indonesia, as of AKKI founding, reported 1 March 2025
quoted_support: "Menurut Dewan Pendiri AKKI, Adrian Zakhary, Indonesia saat ini memiliki sekitar 17 juta kreator yang berpeluang memberikan kontribusi besar di berbagai sektor."

claim: The Google-Temasek-Bain 2021 report projected Indonesia's digital economy would reach USD 70 billion by 2025, cited as macro context for creator-economy growth.
stance_target: overall Indonesian digital economy growth trajectory
scope_conditions: Indonesia, digital economy overall (not creator-specific), 2021 report projecting to 2025
quoted_support: "Laporan yang diterbitkan oleh Google, Temasek, dan Bain & Company pada 2021 memperkirakan bahwa ekonomi digital Indonesia akan mencapai nilai 70 miliar dollar AS pada 2025."

claim: We Are Social's 2023 report found 212 million internet users in Indonesia, averaging 8 hours per day online, cited as context for the creative fertile ground for content creators.
stance_target: size of the Indonesian internet-using population available to content creators
quoted_support: "Menurut laporan We Are Social 2023, pengguna internet di Indonesia mencapai 212 juta orang, dengan rata-rata waktu online 8 jam per hari."
